# Bundled Diffusers runtime

This directory contains Hugging Face Diffusers 0.17.0.dev0 used by OrgaCast.

Install from the OrgaCast repository root:

```bash
pip install -e ./vendor/diffusers --no-deps
```

See the [OrgaCast README](../../README.md) for environment setup and usage.
